text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Dundas Street West, City Council approval of this report is required. Pomerleau, is constructing a 10-storey affordable housing building. The site is located on the south side of Dundas Street West, east of Ossington Avenue. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the south sidewalk and a portion of the eastbound curb lane on Dundas Street West, between a point 44 metres east of Ossington Avenue and a point 39 metres further east, for a period of 24 months, from September 1, 2026 to September 1, 2028, in order to facilitate construction staging operations. During the closure period, pedestrians will be accommodated within a temporary covered and protected walkway located in the closed portion of the eastbound curb lane.
